fields.label: Default Cost Center
fields.description: Must not be a group cost centre.

fields.label: Auto Submit Vouchers
fields.description: Leave off to review before posting to the ledger.

fields.label: Payment Matching
fields.description: How incoming transfers are matched to outstanding invoices.

fields.label: Match Payments Automatically
fields.description: Settle an invoice when the evidence is strong enough. Weaker matches are queued for review instead.

fields.label: Minimum Match Score
fields.description: Out of roughly 110. A quoted invoice number alone scores 60; number plus exact amount scores 85.

fields.label: Look Back (days)
fields.description: How far back to search for an unpaid invoice.

fields.label: Amount Tolerance
fields.description: Accept a transfer short by up to this much and post the difference as a bank charge. Set to the typical interbank fee, e.g. 6500.

fields.label: Bank Charges Account
fields.description: Where the shortfall goes when a transfer arrives net of fees.

fields.label: Default Expense Item
fields.description: Used only when a rule creates a Purchase Invoice.

fields.label: Suspense Account
fields.description: Optional. Where unmatched lines post if you choose to force posting.
